name: knowledge-base
description: Read-only retrieval from a locally configured Markdown knowledge base. Browse chapters, sections, and source-linked entries.

interface.shortDescription: Browse a locally configured Markdown knowledge base in stages.
interface.longDescription: Reads Markdown entries from DOD_GUARD_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_DIR and returns chapter, section, summary, and full-content views separately. Configure the local root before starting the server.
defaultPrompt: Search the knowledge base and retrieve one selected entry.
